Plot an igraph network on a leaflet map

Source: R/leaflet.R
plot_leaflet.Rd

Draws each vertex as a clustered marker at its coordinates and each edge as a grey line between the vertices it connects.

Usage

plot_leaflet(g, lat, lon, col = "site", label = "none", tile = "Default")

Arguments

g

An igraph object.

lat

Name of the vertex attribute holding latitude.

lon

Name of the vertex attribute holding longitude.

col

Name of the vertex attribute used to colour markers, or "none" to draw every marker in black. Colours are recycled if there are more than 19 groups.

label

Name(s) of the vertex attribute(s) shown in marker labels, each on its own line as attribute: value, or "none" to label markers with the vertex name.

tile

Background tiles: "Default" (OpenStreetMap), "Terrain" (Stadia Stamen Terrain), or any other value for Stadia Stamen Terrain Background.

Value

A leaflet htmlwidget.

Examples

plot_leaflet(example_network, "lat", "long", col = "site")


plot_leaflet(example_network, "lat", "long", col = "site", label = "site")


plot_leaflet(
  example_network, "lat", "long",
  col = "site", label = c("name", "site")
)
